note: Precomputed corpus facts for the immutable 2026-07-v2.1 response set. Generated once from data/runs/2026-07-v2.1/responses (which is CI tree-hash pinned and can never change), so the research pages do not re-read 2,576 files on every build. Bound to the corpus two ways: corpusDigest below must equal V21_RECORD.corpusDigest at runtime (research.ts refuses the file otherwise), and packages/runner/test/corpus-facts.test.ts recomputes every number from the real responses via the production reader and fails if any digit drifts.
